scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Stationery To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students
other_conditions: Student must be studying in Class 1 to 12 in a government, aided or recognized public school
Attendance should not be less than 70 % in the preceding year
Applicant should not be receiving any centrally sponsored scholarship scheme together with the state‑funded scheme
Applicant must upload a SC/ST/OBC/Minorities certificate issued by the concerned district office of Delhi
Applicant must upload a domicile document as proof of residence in Delhi
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of Rs 1,000 per year for classes I–VIII and Rs 2,000 per year for classes IX–XII.
documents_required: SC/ST/OBC/Minorities certificate issued by concerned district office Delhi
